text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BANGLADESH, March 4 - Chittagong - 19 Vessels in port of which 3 containers, 5 general cargo, 5 foodgrain, 3 others, 1 cement, 2 fertiliser. 28 Vessels due by 11/3 of which 15 containers, 6 general cargo, 1 foodgrain, 1 repairs, 1 export loader, 1 scrap, 3 tankers, no berthing delays.

INDIA, March 4 - Bombay - Delays expected for vessels due, containers 1-2 days, bulkers 10-12 days, general cargo 1-2 days. 7 Vessels loading at berth, 22 discharging at berth, 5 waiting at anchorage to load, 9 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 3 under repair, 1 awaiting orders. Calcutta - 15 Vessels due of which 3 coking coal, 5 product tankers, 3 crude, 4 containers. 7 Vessels loading at berth, 12 discharging at berth, 1 bunkering. Cochin - Four vessels due, up to 1 day delay expected. 3 Vessels loading at berth, 6 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 bunkering, 1 tug, 1 small vessel, 1 general cargo under repair/drydock.

Chennai (madras) - 32 Vessels due by 10/3. Delays expected, coal/coke 3-4 days, fertiliser 2-3 days, scrap 4-5 days, others 2-3 days, no delays for containers and iron ore. 2 Vessels loading at berth, 11 discharging at berth, 3 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 vessel under repair/drydock. Mormugao - 14 Vessels due, 4-5 days delay expected. 1 Vessel loading at berth, 1 loading at anchorage, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 2 vessels under repair, 1 awaiting orders.

Kandla - 21 Vessels due, 4-5 days delay expected. 4 Vessels loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth, 3 waiting at anchorage to load, 27 tankers. Mangalore - Seven vessels due, up to 1 day delay expected, 5 loading/discharging at berth, 2 waiting berth. Jawaharlal Nehru - Six vessels due, no berthing delays expected. 1 Vessel loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Paradip - Vessels due, 4 coal, 4 iron, 1 oil, 2-3 days delay expected. 4 Vessels loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge.

Tuticorin - Three vessels due, no delays expected. 1 Vessel loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth, 1 discharging at anchorage, 5 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 2 vessels under repair. Visakhapatnam - 20 Vessels due. Delays expected, up to 1 day for iron ore, pig iron, wheat, sulphur, caustic soda, 7-8 days for soyabean meal, granite blocks, dap, limestone, iron ore, rock phosphate, liquid ammonia, 1-2 days for coking coal. 4 Vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge at inner harbour berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load at inner harbour berth.

MALAYSIA, March 5 - Port Kelang - North/south port - Container/ro-ro berth - 8 Vessels alongside, 10 waiting, 2 days waiting time. Deep draft conventional wharf, 4 vessels alongside, 2 berthed, 3 waiting, 1 days waiting time. Dry/cement bulk terminal - 2 Vessels alongside, 4 waiting, 3 days waiting time. Liquid bulk terminal - 4 Vessels alongside, 7 waiting, 2 days waiting time. West port - Container/ro-ro berth - 2 Vessels alongside. Deep draft conventional wharf - 8 Alongside, 3 waiting, 2 days waiting time. Bulk cement terminal - 1 Alongside. Liquid bulk terminal - No vessels.

MAURITIUS, March 4 - Port Louis - Two container vessels alongside discharging and loading, 3 general cargo vessels alongside discharging, 1 vessel at outer anchorage awaiting berth for discharging, no idle vessels. Fishing port very busy, 12 vessels alongside for discharging and transhipment, 13 at buoys berth waiting to discharge.

PAKISTAN, March 3 - Karachi - Eight vessels due. Delays expected, 1 day for general cargo, 8 days for rice/general meal, 46 days for fertiliser. 8 Vessels loading at berth (rice, general meal). 3 Container vessels loading and discharging at berth, 8 discharging at berth (dap, urea, general cargo, hsd, mtb/meg). 2 Rice vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 10 waing at anchorage to discharge (fertiliser, tankers, oil, general cargo. 2 Vessels awaiting orders/crew change. Port Qasim - One vessel loading rice at berth, 3 discharging at berth (palm oil, wheat, iron ore), 3 waiting at anchorage to load (rice, crude oil). 7 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (coal, palm oil, lpg, wheat and fuel oil).

PHILIPPINES, March 3 - Manila - South harbour - 6 Vessels discharging at berth, 6 discharging at anchorage, 2 waiting at outside anchorage to discharge, 2 under repair/drydock. 16 Other vessels in port, no congestion, 2 awaiting berth at pier 13. Holidays 27/3, 28/3, 29/3.

SIERRA LEONE, March 3 - Freetown - Port closed 28/3. On 29/3, 30/3 and 31/3 port will work on overtime. Gangs and pilot need to be booked 48 hours in advance. Vessels due, 1 container discharger, 1 container/vehicles discharger, no delays expected. Discharging/loading at berth, 1 salt discharger, 1 aid cargo discharger, 1 vessel anchored. Vessels must in in/out of port before 1900 hours.

SINGAPORE, March 4 - Singapore - Tanjong Pagar container terminal - 9 Container vessels berthed. Keppel - 9 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Pasir Panjang - 14 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Sembawang - 2 General cargo vessels berthed. Jurong - 1 Bulk cargo/steel/general cargo vessels berthed. Oil terminal - 22 Tankers berthed. Minimum berthing delays at all facilities.

SOUTH KOREA, March 4 - Inchon - 64 Vessels in port (40 berthed, 24 anchored) of which 7 general cargo, 5 each logs, containers, 4 each steel, corn, 3 cars, 2 scrap, 1 each pulp, steel plates, soybean, wheat blending pellets, steel billets, coils, h-beam, plywood, raw sugar, cotton seed meal. Anchored, 7 general cargo, 5 containers, 2 each logs, steel, 1 each pig iron, scrap, l fertiliser, wheat blending pellets, plywood, coils, molasses, tapioca, approx. 1 days berthing delay. Busan - 141 Vessels in port (44 berthed, 97 anchored including 47 laid up) of which 33 general cargo, 5 containers, 3 each scrap, coal. 50 Vessels awaiting berth with approx. 1-2 days delay expected.

Pohang - 23 Vessels in port (21 berthed, 2 anchored) of which discharging, 3 bilts, 2 each coal, slabs, coils, scrap, 1 each iron ore, plates, pipes, magnesite. 6 Vessels loading steel, 2 awaiting berth with approx. 1 days delay expected. Ulsan - 17 Vessels berthed of which discharging, 1 each feed meal, coal, paraxylene, propylene, sugar, lead concentrates, propane, fuel oil, crude oil. Loading, 2 general cargo, 2 fertiliser, 1 each sugar, resin, fuel oil, paraxylene, no berthing delays expected. Masan - 10 Vessels berthed of which discharging, 3 scrap, 1 each silica sand, tapioca, bananas, clay, slabs. 2 Vessels loading vehicles, no berthing delays expected.

SRI LANKA, March 4 - Colombo - Vessels due, 8 containers, 1 bagged sugar, delays of 1-2 days for conventional vessels. Loading at berth, 2 essential services, 10 container vessels. Discharging at berth, 3 bagged sugar, 10 containers, 1 bulk lpg, 1 steel, 1 bulk palm oil, 1 bulk gypsum, 1 bagged flour, 1 bulk cement, 1 general cargo, 3 essential services, 3 ro-ro. 1 Container vessel waiting at anchorage to load, 1 bagged maize waiting at anchorage to discharge, 4 vessels bunking, 6 under repair/drydock, 7 awaiting orders. Galle - No vessels. Trincomalee - One vessel loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth.

TAIWAN, March 3 - Keelung - Four vessels anchored. Berthing delays grain 5 days, coal, steel 4 days, iron ore 3 days. Kaohsiung - Three vessels anchored. Berthing delays of 1 day for grain, steel, iron/coal (CSC berth), coal/scrap (public berth). Taichung - Six vessels anchored. Berthing delays grain 1 day, iron ore, coal, scrap, steel, others 1-2 days.
THAILAND, Feb 28 - Bangkok - 80 Vessels in port of which 6 containers, 1 tanker, 73 other bulkers and general cargo vessels, 9 vessels waiting at outer anchorage, 1-2 days berthing delay expected.
